errors.problem: 2^{2b+4}(u*v) is the digit convolution in tensor (prime-axis) order, i.e. its image under Phi. The paper says 'whose inverse image under Phi is the original integer coefficient convolution'. The page's own formula applies Phi^{-1} afterwards, so the argument is unaffected.
